verdict_reason: Tests prove links carry the ticked address and keep q and page, but nothing pins the radio-only guard against change events from the search box in the same form.

todos.issue: No test covers the radio-only guard in picker-paging-selection.js:20 (target.matches(RADIO_SELECTOR)). The picker form also holds the search box (address-book-picker/template.njk: appSubmittedSearch id q inside the form with data-module), so a change event on it reaches the listener; deleting the guard would write selected=<search text> into every paging link and no test in this file would go red. render() builds the form without a search input, so the case cannot be exercised today.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails when the module rewrites paging links on a change event from a non-radio control in the picker form, such as the search box. One way: add a text input name=q to render()'s markup and a test 'Should leave the paging links alone when the search text changes' that dispatches change on it and asserts the exact original hrefs.
